harnessFindings.scriptProxyFault: figdes_use_figma mutating scripts fail with 'proxy: inconsistent get'; readonly children traversal degrades mid-session ('cannot convert to object'); single-node micro reads and inspect_visual/find_node stay usable — all mutations therefore ran through the modify_design allowlisted op path (38 clean commits)
harnessFindings.pageFallbackFault: one large multi-op transaction silently parented its created texts to a canvas PAGE instead of the addressed frame; applied-counts still reported success; detected only by re-finding created names and reading parents; lesson recorded: verify created-node parents after any tx over ~10 ops
harnessFindings.idGuessFault: referencing ids that were never captured (future tx ids, or adjacent-node arithmetic) either rejects cleanly (pre/'Node not found', zero commit) or — worse — silently targets a wrong-but-existing node (rename/content swaps on the case-8 cluster map and case-9 run lines); discipline recorded: temp ids from the response's applied list only, name-based finds otherwise, pre-write content checks
harnessFindings.setSizeFaultScope: 'set_minWidth: 0' breaking applies to the autolayout slot/chip frames; setSize on the case-9 hero (free composition) worked — the fault is not global
harnessFindings.hugGrowth: autolayout hug chips grow when values are appended — the reliable value-filling path on all nine fixtures
harnessFindings.textReorder: appendChild rejects TEXT children; label/value order fixes done by content+typography exchange
harnessFindings.needsApproval: one removal paused with needs-approval and succeeded after an explicit approved+reason resend — the pause is a working deliberate gate
harnessFindings.pipelineTimeouPattern: design_pipeline mode build responses timed out on 3 of 6 build cases while the server kept applying afterwards — late-arriving build output must be expected between the first render and later renders; committed frames always verified afterwards
harnessFindings.buildStamps: the connected plugin never reported a build stamp, so no live verdict can be tied to a commit — the recorded recommendation (rebuild + reopen the plugin) stands for future runs

expectedUse: the report in docs/issue-22-report.md summarizes this; per-case evidence lives in the sibling JSONs; the frozen offline baseline stays the regression reference and is not re-scored here
